archetypes.name: oos-flow
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes the OOS disposition lifecycle across manifest materialization, sentinels, NDJSON evidence, and gate clearing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the end-to-end OOS flow from external implementer manifest through accepted-OOS markdown, issue sentinel generation, larch-log evidence, disposition checkpoint, and OOS_PENDING clearing. Look for paths where manifest-only, design-export-only, all-already-filed, deduplicated, or partial-failure OOS could be skipped or falsely treated as disposed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-state
archetypes.rationale: New shell paths alter ship-pr, checkpoint, and step2 behavior with state files, helper calls, and fail-open/fail-closed branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the bash changes for ordering, state mutation, errexit handling, quoting, missing executable checks, and temporary/log file behavior. Pay special attention to materialize-manifest-oos.sh invocation before OOS triggers, count-only semantics, and whether failures conservatively preserve OOS_PENDING without masking real errors. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: python-parity
archetypes.rationale: Python ship flow now mirrors bash OOS routing and must stay behaviorally equivalent across path resolution and gate inputs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python ship.py and oos.py changes against the bash checkpoint and ship-pr behavior described by the plan. Check design OOS path resolution order, manifest materialization timing, filed URL strictness, run-id fallback, commit-range selection, and NEEDS_USER_OOS_FILING handling for parity gaps. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: public-redaction
archetypes.rationale: The new materializer moves untrusted manifest text into public OOS artifacts and separates security-routed observations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect how manifest titles, descriptions, phases, and focus-area values are sanitized before being written to public OOS files or committed logs. Verify that dedicated security focus-area blocks are routed privately without leaking sensitive details, while prose mentions are not over-classified, and that redaction cannot be bypassed by multiline or structured input. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
